title: DPWH eyes December completion of EDSA sidewalk expansion from Pasay to Makati

blocks.text: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is targeting to complete the expansion of sidewalks along EDSA, from Roxas Boulevard in Pasay City to Guadalupe in Makati City before the end of the year, Secretary Vince Dizon said Wednesday.
